bead.title: Add in-process sticky route leases
bead.description: Add an in-process route lease store for sticky local endpoint assignment. In-scope files: internal/routing or internal/routehealth lease store package, service routing wiring only as needed to pass a validated sticky key, and focused tests. Requirements: key leases by sticky route key plus resolved provider/model scope; store provider, endpoint, model, acquired/refreshed/expires timestamps; refresh on reuse; expire abandoned leases; invalidate leases when endpoint disappears, stops advertising the model, or enters cooldown. Role remains observational; validated CorrelationID is the first sticky key source unless a more specific worker/session key already exists. Out of scope: provider utilization probes, route scoring with utilization, route-status UI, and distributed/shared lease backend.
bead.acceptance: 1. go test ./internal/routing ./... -run 'Sticky|Lease|Routing' passes. 2. Same sticky key repeatedly returns the same provider endpoint while the lease is live and endpoint remains eligible. 3. Expired sticky key is assigned fresh. 4. Removed, unavailable, or model-mismatched endpoint invalidates the lease and records an invalidation reason. 5. Different sticky keys can hold different endpoint leases concurrently without data races.
